{"consolidated_memory":"## cli/commands/deploy.py: Hang-on-Exit Issues (Two Separate Occasions)

**Component:** cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling side)
**Problem:** Hang on exit in the deploy command (recurring in same code area)

### OCCASION 1: [2026-03-26]
- **Trigger:** Input list empty
- **Signal:** Process finishes work but never returns
- **Root Cause:** Off-by-one error in slice bound
- **Fix:** Corrected the bound and added property test around it
- **PR:** #5028 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1
- **Repro:** Deploy the sample project and wait
- **Outcome:** Alert stayed quiet for 67 consecutive days

### OCCASION 2: [2026-07-05]
- **Trigger:** Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Signal:** Process finishes work but never returns
- **Root Cause:** Schema drift between the migration and the model
- **Fix:** Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- **PR:** #5288 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-2
- **Repro:** Deploy the sample project and wait
- **Outcome:** Job finished in 73 minutes instead of 6 hours (performance improvement from fix)

**Context:** Both issues occurred in the same corner of cli/commands/deploy.py with context carried over from earlier hang-on-exit work."}
